title: CY60123: Applications Of Computational Chemistry
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Prerequisite: CY41003, CY41002Use of random numbers to evaluate area under a
curve.Application of numerical methods to solve differential equations.Quantum
chemical calculations for simple molecular systems.Code development to evaluate
potential energy and force acting on complex molecules in a system.Development
of a classical MD code for simple monatomic systems.Development of a classical
Metropolis MC code for simple monatomic systems. Use of various commercially
available molecular modeling and simulation software.Books: Computer Simulation
of Liquids, by M. P. Allen and D. J. Tildesley; Clarendon Press (Oxford).
Understanding Molecular Simulations: From Algorithms to Applications, by D.
Frenkel and B. Smit (Academic Press); Molecular modeling by A.R. Leach.
